name: Painter choice
responsibility: Chooses the painter of a canvas once, from what the browser says: Vello on WebGPU when it gives a real adapter and a device, Vello on the CPU otherwise
description: A software adapter, or none, sends the canvas to the CPU painter, and the rule reads no frame back. If the GPU fails to start or in a frame, the CPU painter takes over on a fresh canvas, because a canvas that held a WebGPU context never takes a 2D one. The caller shows which painter draws, and why the GPU does not.

outgoing.label: start the GPU or the CPU painter
